CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: O Jehovah, my heart is not proud, my eyes are not haughty. I do not involve myself in great matters. I do not get involved in things too difficult for me.
Surely I am composed and quiet. I am like a weaned child who rests against his mother. Inside of me I am like a weaned child.
O Israel, hope in Jehovah from this time and forever.
